itens.titulo: Ethereum Needs to Double to Reach $4,946 Again. XRP Needs 2.6x to Hit $3.65. Which All-Time High Gets Broken First?
itens.descricao: Ethereum Needs to Double to Reach $4,946 Again. XRP Needs 2.6x to Hit $3.65. Which All-Time High Gets Broken First? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Ethereum trades 49% below its $4,946 all-time high, while XRP sits 63% below its $3.65 peak, needing a 2.6x gain to recover.
- Ethereum ETFs hold $15.86 billion, which is 10 times XRP's base, but nine straight days of outflows signal fading institutional demand.
- Ethereum reclaimed its 2018 high in roughly 3 years; XRP took over 7 years, giving ETH a stronger historical recovery track record.
(Sponsor) Ethereum (CRYPTO:ETH) trades at $2,531, about 49% below its all-time high of $4,946 set in August 2025.
Meanwhile, XRP (CRYPTO:XRP) stands at $1.36, roughly 63% below its peak of $3.65 recorded on July 17, 2025.
CoinMarketCap shows XRP's peak at $3.84 on January 4, 2018, because it includes older exchanges that were busiest then.
According to that measurement, XRP is currently about 65% below its peak.
In contrast, CoinGecko lists XRP's all-time high at $3.65 in July 2025, while its January 2018 peak was about $3.40 on January 7, 2018.

itens.titulo: Nvidia (NVDA) or Apple (AAPL): Which Is the Better Bet on Dan Ives’ $4 Trillion AI Wave?
itens.descricao: Nvidia (NVDA) or Apple (AAPL): Which Is the Better Bet on Dan Ives’ $4 Trillion AI Wave? Yahoo Finance
trechos: He named the five companies as his top tech picks for 2027, with all five carrying Outperform ratings.
Dan Ives believes investors are underestimating a $4 trillion spending wave.
See which 10 stocks made the list of companies that could change the world by 2030.
Goldman Sachs estimates that AI-related capital investment could total $4 trillion to $8 trillion over the next five years.
Ives describes Nvidia as the "foundational compute platform for the AI economy" and has a $300 price target on the stock.
He expects AI to contribute to Apple's device upgrades and service growth, supporting a $400 price target for the stock.
So far this year, Nvidia has risen about 27% and Apple about 23%.
The stock trades at a forward P/E of just 25.69x, roughly 39% below its five-year average of 42.17x.

itens.titulo: Selic mais baixa à vista? BTG avalia quem ganha com a queda dos juros
itens.descricao: Selic mais baixa à vista? BTG avalia quem ganha com a queda dos juros Money Times
itens.texto:
Selic mais baixa à vista? BTG avalia quem ganha com a queda dos juros
O mercado mudou sua projeção para a taxa Selic em 2026 de 13,50% para 13,25%, segundo as informações divulgadas no Relatório Focus do Banco Central, nesta terça-feira (13). Ou seja, os economistas consultados enxergam possíveis cortes nas últimas reuniões do comitê este ano.
Com um cenário mais benigno para a política monetária, o BTG Pactual enxerga uma melhora marginal para empresas de setores caraterizados pela alta alavancagem, margens líquidas baixas e exposição relevante a dívida indexada à Selic.
Na avaliação do banco, varejistas, incorporadoras de média e alta renda, ações de infraestrutura e de serviços básicos, nomes de mercado de capitais e empresas alavancadas em geral devem se destacar e ganhar um relevante ajuste em um cenário de reduções mais intensas da taxa de juros.
“Juros de curto prazo menores e atividade econômica mais forte podem impulsionar a expansão dos lucros rumo ao fim de 2027 e a 2028, o que poderia estender ainda mais o rali”, avalia a equipe do banco.
De acordo com estudo realizado, a cada redução de 100 pontos-base nos juros locais poderia gerar um impacto relevante na projeção de lucro para 2027 com destaque para Viveo (VVEO3), Ecorodovias (ECOR3), Auren (AURE3), Minerva (BEEF3), Hapvida (HAPV3), Magazine Luiza (MGLU3), Cosan (CSAN3), Energisa (ENGI11), Equatorial (EQTL3), PagSeguro (PAGS34), Randon (RAPT4), Simpar (SIMH3), Movida (MOVI3), Vamos (VAMO3) e Assaí (ASAI3).
Ainda nesta avalição, o BTG destaca que o varejo é o grande destaque entre os que se beneficiam desse movimento, já que uma taxa de juros mais baixa impulsiona a atividade econômica e melhora as condições de crédito. No setor imobiliário, as incorporadoras de média e alta renda também tendem a ser as mais sensíveis aos ciclos de afrouxamento monetário.

itens.titulo: Applied Optoelectronics Is Up 175% in 2026 and Lumentum Is Up 164%: Take Profits, or Hold On for the Ride?
itens.descricao: Applied Optoelectronics Is Up 175% in 2026 and Lumentum Is Up 164%: Take Profits, or Hold On for the Ride? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - AAOI and LITE have surged 175% and 164% in 2026, fueled by soaring AI data center demand for optical hardware.
- SOXX gained 79% and SPY just 14% this year, but AAOI's 9% monthly pullback shows how quickly sentiment can shift on smaller names.
- The industry's shift from 800G to 1.6T transceivers threatens to reset pricing and open fresh battles for market share among optical suppliers.
Applied Optoelectronics (NASDAQ:AAOI) stock trades at $95.94, up 175% year to date.
Meanwhile, Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) stock is at $973.77, up 164% year to date, close behind the group leader.
At the same time, Coherent (NYSE:COHR) stock trades at $286.05, up 55% year to date, a strong gain that still trails both leaders by a wide margin.
For sector context, the iShares Semiconductor ETF (NASDAQ:SOXX) is up 79% year to date.
By comparison, the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (NYSEARCA:SPY) is up 14% in 2026 so far.

itens.descricao: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Q3 2026 Earnings Call Summary Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick.

Strategic Outlook and Guidance Assumptions - The 2027 NII ex-markets central case of approximately $107 billion assumes continued balance sheet growth, card loan expansion, and current yield curve expectations.
- Expense guidance for 2027 is preliminarily aligned with market consensus of $114 billion, though it remains sensitive to the ongoing budget cycle and AI investment requirements.
- The firm anticipates a normal seasonal decline in markets revenue for Q4, though management noted that global volatility could disrupt typical historical patterns.
- A $52 billion increase in standardized RWA was driven by increased lending across banking and markets, alongside impacts from energy price volatility.
- Net investment securities losses of $658 million were recorded in the Corporate segment, reflecting ongoing portfolio management in the current rate environment.

itens.titulo: LocalStack Adds Support for AWS Lambda Web Functions in Local AWS Sandbox Environments
itens.descricao: LocalStack Adds Support for AWS Lambda Web Functions in Local AWS Sandbox Environments Yahoo Finance
trechos: "Serverless applications have always been such a strong fit for local cloud development.
Introducing Day-1 support for AWS Lambda Web Functions was a no-brainer for us," said Waldemar Hummer, co-founder and CTO of LocalStack.
"It's always encouraging to watch our community evolve from experimenting with these new features locally to building repeatable development workflows based on the local environment.
We're excited to see where the community takes this feature." Traditional serverless functions process events one at a time.
With more than 1,500 customers and hundreds of millions of Docker pulls, LocalStack has become the de facto standard for local cloud development worldwide.
